gen-megrim-gf-liter: Liter stands upright with great vertical presence and wide-mouthed round forms, while Megrim keeps the angular, futuristic display work up top. Paragraphs would glide along without any stroke contrast tugging at the eye.
gen-megrim-gf-martel-sans: Modern in both cases, though Megrim is angular and futuristic while Martel Sans opens every curve generously and keeps its lowercase lifted. Megrim earns its keep in big, short headings.
gen-megrim-gf-matangi: Megrim cuts angular, futuristic letters for the heading, while Matangi presses twine-like strokes into rounded, open letters with a hefty lowercase. Sharp up top, soft and sturdy below, the two sit comfortably together.
gen-megrim-gf-maven-pro: Modern throughout, with Megrim giving angular, futuristic lines up front and Maven Pro adding gentle monotone strokes behind. Megrim is best at display drama; Maven Pro is best at quiet text.
gen-megrim-gf-michroma: Michroma reads wide and spaced out, each letter given a generous berth, its curves leaving plenty of daylight. And Megrim, angular and futuristic, looks best given a large size in the heading.
gen-megrim-gf-miriam-libre: Megrim is angular and futuristic, with a skyward x-height line. The standout quality is how Miriam Libre, with drawn-wire weight and a sturdy lowercase, grounds all that display sharpness approachably.
gen-megrim-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads neutral, with a very large lowercase eye. Longer paragraphs in it would move along in a steady, single-stroke hum beneath the angular, futuristic Megrim headings.
gen-megrim-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: A skyward x-height line gives Megrim its angular, futuristic bite, with a c open like a bent paperclip. Mochiy Pop P One takes over below with a sizable lowercase and generous gaps between letters.
gen-megrim-gf-montserrat-underline: Megrim is angular and futuristic, a display face with a skyward x-height line. It makes the loudest statements, while Montserrat Underline, with breathing counters and oversized lowercase, does the quiet work of the text.
gen-megrim-gf-nokora: Clean and approachable, Nokora lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, with a wide-open s that never tightens. And beneath Megrim, with its angular, futuristic strokes, whole paragraphs would feel dense and inviting.
